speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Given your "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss) and abdominal pain alongside the lymph node, I need to assess for organ involvement. Do you have any history of alcohol consumption or a known liver disease? REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Doctor
text: The liver function tests and ultrasound are normal, which makes primary liver disease or infectious mononucleosis less likely. Given your persistent B symptoms, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph node, we must investigate for malignancy or granulomatous disease. Do you have a history of smoking, and have you had any recent fevers? REQUEST TEST: LDH. REQUEST TEST: ESR.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal liver function tests and ultrasound have ruled out primary liver pathology, and the normal LDH and ESR results are somewhat reassuring but do not exclude malignancy. Given your history of night sweats, weight loss, and a hard, fixed supraclavicular lymph node, I need to know if you have a history of tuberculosis exposure or recent travel to endemic areas. REQUEST TEST: ANA. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal ANA results make systemic lupus erythematosus unlikely. To further evaluate for malignancy, particularly Hodgkin lymphoma given your B symptoms and supraclavicular node, have you experienced any itching (pruritus) or a persistent cough? REQUEST TEST: TSH.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal TSH rules out hyperthyroidism as the cause of your fatigue and weight loss. To definitively address your concerning B symptoms and the hard supraclavicular lymph node, are you experiencing any generalized itching or a persistent cough? I will now request a biopsy of the lymph node and a chest X-ray for final evaluation. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma (pending biopsy confirmation)
